scope: Jurisdiction-level VAT refund guidance for foreign travelers only; this does not establish Rolex designated-store participation, an individual purchaser's eligibility, or a guaranteed refund amount.

sources.title: VAT Refund Guidelines for Foreign Travelers

observedFacts: The guidance sets foreign-traveler entry-document and stay-duration conditions.
Purchases must reach the stated same-day threshold at the same designated store displaying the Taiwan Tax Refund label.
The traveler must apply within the stated period, take the goods out, and receive Customs approval before departure.
limitations: Rolex designated-store participation is not established by this evidence.
No exact transaction-specific refund amount is represented in the comparison.
